description: This file defines the WorkoutCardPresenter class, a custom Presenter for displaying workout media cards in an Android TV application. It manages view creation, styling, focus animations, data binding, and click handling for workout items.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering workout media cards with focus animations, styling, and click handling in an Android TV app.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts a float value in dp to pixels based on device density.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder with styled ImageCardView, including focus animations.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Workout data to the card view, sets images, text, accessibility, and click behavior.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears references and listeners from the view when unbinding.
